A '''battle''' took place in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] on [[JanFathal]]. It started when a workers' strike overthrew the local [[Regent/Legends|Regent]]. Then the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] began an invasion of [[Athar]]. [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|Acclamator-class assault ship]] ''[[Leveler]]'' was present tasked with extracting [[Republic Intelligence/Legends|Agent]] [[Hallena Devis]]. ''[[Leveler]]'' sent new [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] from [[Torrent Company/Legends|Torrent Company]] in along with [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Djinn Altis/Legends|Altis's]] group of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|General Skywalker]] arrived and extracted the group with a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|CIS]] [[CR20 troop carrier/Legends|CR-20 troop carrier]]. The battle ended when [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Battle droid/Legends|Battle droids]] claimed control of [[Athar]].
